resources.name: conferences
resources.description: Conferences related to the current user through an active role or authored submission

fields.name: actor_role
fields.description: The current user's highest-precedence role in the conference

policy_notes: Rows are limited to conferences related to the current user.
Conference access is scoped through active conference roles or authored submissions.

resources.name: public_conferences
resources.description: Public conference information visible in platform exploration and discovery flows
policy_notes: Rows are limited to non-draft conferences.
Only public conference fields are exposed; private operational settings remain hidden.

resources.name: submissions
resources.description: Submissions visible to the current user as author, assigned reviewer, or chair/co-chair

fields.name: actor_role
fields.description: How the current user can see this submission

policy_notes: Rows are limited to submissions related to the current user.
Author identity is not exposed through this resource.

resources.name: assignments
resources.description: Assignments visible to the current user as assigned reviewer or chair/co-chair

fields.name: actor_role
fields.description: How the current user can see this assignment

fields.name: reviewer.email
fields.description: Reviewer email when visible to the current user
fields.redaction_note: Only chairs/co-chairs can see other reviewers. Reviewers can only see their own identity.

policy_notes: Rows are limited to assignments related to the current user.
Reviewer identity is masked unless the current user chairs the conference or the row belongs to them.

resources.name: conference_stats
resources.description: Per-conference statistics visible only to chairs and co-chairs
policy_notes: Rows are limited to conferences where the current user is chair or co-chair.
All fields are pre-aggregated per conference and can be re-aggregated in the DSL.

resources.name: notifications
resources.description: Notifications belonging to the current user
policy_notes: Rows are limited to notifications belonging to the current user.
Rows are limited to conferences where the current user is chair or co-chair.
All fields are pre-aggregated per conference and can be re-aggregated in the DSL.

final_answer:
Tình hình CB406671 hiện khá nhẹ:

- Số bài nộp: 2
- Reviewer/assignment: 0 assignment, 0 review pending, 0 review completed
- Trạng thái hội nghị: `open`
- Cập nhật gần nhất: `2026-07-07T13:44:34Z`

Việc cần chú ý nếu đây là dữ liệu bạn đang theo dõi:
- Chưa có assignment nào được tạo, nên chưa có khối lượng review để xử lý.
- Chưa có bài nào ở trạng thái accepted/rejected; hiện toàn bộ số liệu ngoài `submission_total` đều bằng 0.
- Nếu bạn cần, tôi có thể tóm tiếp theo hướng “việc cần làm ưu tiên” hoặc “báo cáo chair ngắn gọn” cho CB406671.
